'''Team Tournament Formats''' is the [[Players Committee]]'s name, in its ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015), for a two-player team event: one teammate plays Dark Side and the other Light Side against an opposing team.<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' constructed (team event)
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (Alternate Format Tournament Guide, 2015)
* '''Card pool:''' not set by the format; each player brings one deck
* '''In use:''' listed in 2015
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
The guide sets no card pool for team events. Its rules:<ref name="afg" />
* Players form teams of two. One teammate plays their Dark Side deck and the other their Light Side deck.
* Teams are paired against each other; each teammate plays the opposing team's player of the other side.
* If both players on a team win, the team wins the match. If each team wins one game, the team whose winner had the higher differential wins.
* Players keep playing the same deck every round.

== History ==
The guide lists this format under "Alternate Tournament Formats" with [[The Bith Shuffle (format)|The Bith Shuffle]].<ref name="afg" /> Which events used these exact rules is not recorded on this wiki.
